title: Who is responsible?
lead: For every place and topic: who decides, how fast they answer and how your request arrives. Anyone can add their own responsibilities; public offices confirm theirs via their official email.
leadShort: Who is responsible for which place and topic.
placeholder: Topic, place or office, e.g. bike lane, playground, permit
empty: Nothing found. You can still post it as wanted; the community helps to find the right place.
signIn: Sign in to send a request
concern: Your concern in two or three sentences
deadline: Arrives as a card in their inbox. Deadline: 6 weeks. The answer will be public.
footer: Offices receive no direct messages, only structured requests. Someone missing?
intakeLead: Requests to your responsibilities. Answers appear publicly with the project.
